# MDL203 · `group-name-whitespace`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

A group name starts or ends with spaces.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | groups |
| Default severity | error |
| Fix | unsafe |
| Design references | K5 |

## Why

GLib keeps the spaces inside the brackets: [ mydumper ] is the group " mydumper ", which nobody reads.

## Example

❌ Before:

```ini
[ mydumper ]
threads=4
[ `db`.`t` ]
where=1
```

```text
1:2-1:12 error MDL203[group-name-whitespace] the group name " mydumper " has spaces around it: it is not [mydumper]
  = Nobody reads this group: every key in it is ignored.
  fix (unsafe): Remove the spaces
3:2-3:12 error MDL203[group-name-whitespace] the group name " `db`.`t` " has spaces around it: it is not [`db`.`t`]
  = Nobody reads this group: every key in it is ignored.
  fix (unsafe): Remove the spaces
```

✅ After `mydumper-lint check --fix --unsafe-fixes`:

```ini
[mydumper]
threads=4
[`db`.`t`]
where=1
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL203: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL203` on the line above it.
